description: Capability for the tag editor's Tags windows (fork, opt-in). Mirrors the Keyboard shortcuts window, plus: store:default for the settings, shortcuts, and the remembered write kind and numbering options (app-status-store); dialog:allow-ask for 'Discard tag changes?' and the Write anyway / Undo questions; core:window:allow-destroy because onCloseRequested destroys the window from JS once the close is let through (the red button, after closeSelfWindow's Rust close re-raises the request). No window creation: the main window opens Tags windows. The tag-editor commands go through the tauri_specta invoke handler, not the capability ACL.
